section_duties.39.3/MP-0: written (writable part), route insertion pending: L^k_{infty omega}/FO^k grammar with variable reuse (body 35-236: def:p03-w03-p03-056-vocabulary, -grammar, -semantics, -equivalence; lemmas -coincidence, -renaming, -walks, -finitely-many); k-pebble game with placement, reuse, removal and partial-isomorphism win condition after every move, plus source variants (body 237-347: def:p03-w03-p03-056-pebble-game, thm -atomic, def -method); finite-round and eternal equivalence theorems (body 348-395: thm:p03-w03-p03-056-finite-round, -eternal), monotonicity/equivalence-relation corollary and Kolaitis Cor. 7.10 definability theorem (body 397-453: -monotone, -definability); worked examples (body 454-521: -cliques, -even, -clique-query, -orders), limitation (body 522-573: -successor, -limits), relationships (body 575-633: -ef-bridge). Every proof in annex 1-833 (annex:p03-w03-p03-056-*). The body/annex files are not yet input by any driver: driver inserts and a cross-reference in readonly host n-c-002.tex are filed as patch requests in work/waves/w03a/patches/w03a-p03-056.json (lead executes).
